comparison.objective: Fill and remove a vacuum blood tube while keeping an inserted needle stationary; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a holder continuously while inserting, filling, extracting, and placing a tube versus fastener/collar adjustment and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Needle displacement ≤2 mm, stopper pierced, tube filled, removed and released in tray, holder continuously held; candidate requires safe dynamic stops.
comparison.reason: The medical task’s central ability is disturbance-free exchange under continuous stabilization.
